{{Quote|What are those?''"<br />"''Coin-crabs. Reminds me of those happy days we spent frying Yuuzhan Vong.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Goran Beviin]]|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
'''Deep-fried coin-crabs''' were a type of seafood [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] served at the [[Horizon Hotel]] bar on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Utilizing local [[coin-crab]]s,<ref name="Bloodlines" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the Tarisian [[Beach/Legends|coastlines]], the small, tasty [[Crab/Legends|crabs]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> were deep-fried and served to patrons in bowls.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the veteran [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Goran Beviin]] ordered a bowl of deep-fried [[Coin/Legends|coin]]-crabs while visiting the Horizon Hotel.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Beviin enjoyed the crabs' crunchiness, and likened the deep-fried crustaceans to the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] whom the Mandalorians had fought close to a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] prior, during the species' [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deep-fried coin-crabs were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel [[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines|''Bloodlines'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[August 29]], [[2006]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />
